entities.summary: Michael Rasmussen is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a centre for the Detroit Red Wings of the National Hockey League (NHL). Rasmussen was drafted ninth overall by the Red Wings in the 2017 NHL entry draft. He was born in Vancouver, and grew up in the neighboring suburb of Surrey.
